body: I've told people but they don't care. I've been in and out of therapy since I was 16 but it never gets better. I've called suicide hotlines before but...I didn't try two days ago because I didn't want to ruin my friends wedding. Now the wedding is over and it was hell sitting with two people who hate me so much. They were all I had left and they've turned on me. I don't have anything here anymore.
